acceptedInterpretation: Implement an explicit, host-neutral, non-authoritative playbook lifecycle closure: historical seeds may be batch-backfilled into inert candidates; trial/matched-control may record candidate exposure/control observations; timer automation may run bounded backfill/sweep/activation commands but cannot turn candidate into active unless the existing evidence-activation policy and explicit outcome guards pass.
notes: Reject the broader interpretation that historical seed presence or story DONE success should auto-activate playbooks. This story closes throughput and experiment orchestration, not authority or gate evidence.
